author: Noah Fuller
title: Robert F. Kennedy Jr. Takes Cold Plunge In Jeans In Odd MAHA 'Fitness' Video With Kid Rock - NewsBreak
text:
By Noah Fuller ,
5 hours ago Robert F. Kennedy Jr ., the Health and Human Services secretary, has recorded himself taking an ice bath and working out in his jeans in an exercise video.
Kennedy, 72, posted a 90-second clip on social media that shows him working out alongside Kid Rock as part of his “Make America Healthy Again” mission. The caption read, “I’ve teamed up with Kid Rock to deliver two simple messages to the American people: GET ACTIVE + EAT REAL FOOD.”
Kennedy is known for posting odd social media videos, including one last year where he swam with his grandkids in a polluted creek .
The video, self-declared as “Secretary Kennedy and Kid Rock’s Rock Out Work Out,” showcases the pair doing various exercises, most of which are shirtless, including a scene in which Kid Rock flips off the camera while Kennedy does push-ups in the sauna.
Throughout the short montage, Kennedy is exclusively in jeans, which he has often been filmed in while exercising, and even appears to be taking a plunge into an ice bath and jumping into a swimming pool.
In August 2025, Kennedy revealed his reasoning for working out in jeans during an interview on Fox News’ Jesse Watters Primetime .
Subscribe To Our Cheat Sheet!One week of pop culture news in your inbox! “Well, I just started doing that a long time ago because I would go hiking in the morning and then I’d go straight to the gym, and I found it was convenient, and now I’m used to it, so I just do it,” he said in the interview.
The clip ends with Kennedy and Kid Rock in a hot tub, drinking whole milk.
On January 14, Donald Trump signed the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act, allowing schools to serve students whole milk.
The post is set to Kid Rock’s “Bawitdaba” – the song that he opened his Turning Point USA Halftime performance with. The musician was accused of lip-syncing the track during the alternative programming to Bad Bunny ‘s 2026 Super Bowl LX Halftime Show. He denied the claims.
“It was just a syncing issues that they had, and I know they tried to get it right. It was very difficult,” Kid Rock said.
